_comment: RVPS reference values for mvhd-trustee on Azure (ADR-069): what Trustee's default attestation policy (default_cpu, SNP section) compares SEV-SNP evidence from the ACI groups with. Take each value from the first attestation (21-aci-confidential-spe.sh --check prints the loader's 'pinnable claims'), check snp_launch_measurement against Microsoft's endorsement of the UVM (reference-info-base64 in the group), save a copy outside the repository with the placeholders replaced, and run 21-aci-confidential-spe.sh --trustee --reference-values <file>. A list is 'one of', a scalar an exact value. The resource policy (resource-azure.rego.tmpl) additionally requires HOST_DATA to be the permit's policy hash.
